exposure: Long-term immunosuppressive treatment (prednisone and azathioprine) for autoimmune hepatitis/sclerosing cholangitis
cohort: Pregnant women diagnosed with autoimmune hepatitis or autoimmune sclerosing cholangitis during childhood
finding: Pregnancy in women treated long-term with immunosuppressants for autoimmune hepatitis/sclerosing cholangitis diagnosed during childhood is possible with good maternal and neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was performed in 3 out of 15 pregnancies (23%).
